name: hono-openapi-starter
description: Hono + React full-stack starter with OpenAPI-driven type safety

scripts.build: pnpm --filter backend build && pnpm --filter frontend build
scripts.package:backend: node scripts/backend/clean-release.mjs && pnpm --filter backend build && pnpm --filter backend --prod deploy .artifacts/backend && node scripts/backend/verify-release.mjs
scripts.test: pnpm test:scripts && pnpm --filter backend test && pnpm --filter frontend test
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter backend typecheck && pnpm --filter frontend typecheck && pnpm --filter e2e typecheck
